structured.answer: Per this page: hold it at פסגות and buy the ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) fund (5139282). That ends at about 86.5k ₪ on 70k paid in. The broker matters far more (up to ~23k ₪) than the fund (up to ~4.5k ₪).

findings.what: A broker name (פסגות) is the big headline winner, with no visible info on who runs the site or whether anyone is paid
מיטב טרייד at 63,507 means ~23k lost on 70k deposited; looks plainly off without a breakdown
A 0%-fee tracker shown as '+0.37%' over just one year, presented as a selling point
No US-listed ETF option; only one 'קרן חוץ בת"א', so I can't compare with what I actually hold
Tick marks on the comparison strips have no labels except at the ends
Some prices are crowdsourced ('קיבלתם מחיר אחר? ספרו לנו'), which makes me wonder how accurate the fee data is
Projection return assumption not shown anywhere on the first screen
